name: sistem-cbr-estimasi-lama-hukuman-pidana
description: Aplikasi tugas kuliah estimasi lama hukuman pidana dengan penalaran berbasis kasus

scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:web && npm run build:api
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b packages/cbr packages/data tools/importer tools/cli apps/api --pretty && npm run typecheck --workspace @cbr/web
scripts.db:migrate: npm run build:packages && node tools/cli/dist/index.js migrate
scripts.db:status: npm run build:packages && node tools/cli/dist/index.js status
